Hello,

Changelog:

  • Toggle Custom Style: adds a checkbox in subverses that have a custom style used to toggle it.
  • Added shortcut keys to navigate to the top and the bottom of the page (selecting the first or the last post).
  • I also rewrote parts of the core code to allow modules to be started before the page is fully loaded. This, coupled with the optimizations, will reduce the "snapping effect"; i.e. AVE appearing at once a second after the page appears to be loaded.
  • NeverEndingVoat now has a better control over the possible errors that can happen when loading next page.
  • In the filter modules, you now need to separate filters by commas instead of by spaces. "Cecil the lion" is now an acceptable filter that isn't transformed into three different filters ("cecil", "the", "lion").
  • The modules modifying the subverse bar at the top and the user info block will now try to adapt to the current custom style.
  • I took some time to optimize two modules that were taking a long time to process (more than 300ms each).
  • In the preference manager, an option has been added to trigger an alert and ask you to confirm if you are exiting and have unsaved changes. Also, the save button changes when you modify a setting.
  • The version notifier can now be disabled. It won't appear after downloading a new version of AVE.

And more in the complete changelog.

  • Would anyone be interested in the ability to choose a default style and have it applied to Voat entirely (overriding the custom styles everywhere), you could choose from a list of selection (Typogra, Scribble, ...) or input an url (of a userstyle for example).
